description: This file defines the Entity Framework Core DbContext implementation for the Conduit application, including DbSet properties for entities, model configuration, and transaction management.

classes.name: ConduitContext
classes.description: Entity Framework Core DbContext implementation for managing database access, entity configurations, and transaction handling in the Conduit application.

methods.name: BeginTransaction
methods.description: Starts a new database transaction if one isn't already active and if the database is not in-memory.

methods.name: CommitTransaction
methods.description: Commits the current transaction, with error handling to rollback in case of failure.

methods.name: RollbackTransaction
methods.description: Rolls back and disposes the current transaction if active.
